8.0: 1. Grandma’s stew. 2. Pizza, the burnt one from the campsite. 3. Cereal, at night, standing up. Do not tell Mom about number three.

28.0: Treehouse. I get seasick in the bathtub. But we would need a rope bridge to the kitchen, or I would starve by Tuesday.

64.0: Climbing on the school roof to get the ball back. Five times. The ball was not even mine. I just liked the view, and I never told anyone that until now.

84.0: The day you lost the match and went over to shake hands first. You thought I was not looking. I had to pretend there was something in my eye.

9.0: 1. Tacos. 2. Your pancakes. 3. Tacos again. You never said they had to be different.

29.0: Boat. I would be captain. You could fish from the treehouse and wave.

65.0: Talking. And once for putting a frog in a pencil case. He was fine.

85.0: When you learned to swim this year so you could come in with me.

This is just between the two of you. Nobody else needs to read it. 4
